summary: ORIX Corporation filed a 6-K report containing its consolidated financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, alongside notices regarding share repurchase, dividend, management changes, board candidates, and articles amendment. The management changes appear routine (appointment/nomination), not a forced departure. The filing is primarily a routine periodic update. No special-situation trigger is present. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as an annual results release. What to watch: any material divergence from prior guidance.
